items.title: Jessie Charles Interview, 1967-12-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Martin Sher. And I'm Dick Allen.

ctx.x: Martin Sher. And I'm Dick Allen. All right. So, let's see. What's today's date? It's December the... What is it? Um... Today. December the 15th on the newspaper. Yes. Bill of Rights Day. That's right. I read that. Up at school. See, I got some stuff. Oh, you got it all written down.
I got a little jot down here. Not much of it.
